description: Create a shop for an owner who has already accepted the current Terms and Privacy. That acceptance is for the person and covers every shop they own or join. Send accept_terms true, the shop name, the jurisdiction and the owner's name and email. This does not accept for the owner and it does not email the Terms. If the owner has not accepted yet, the call is refused and names the missing document and /p/legal. The reply has an agent key for the new shop, shown once.

accept_terms.description: true: the owner already accepted the current Terms and Privacy. One acceptance covers every shop.

accept_terms_version.description: Optional: the Terms version you reviewed (now terms-2026-11-10a). Refused if it is not the current one.

agent_name.description: Your name, used as the key label
